passages.note: General property-tax depreciation schedule for business personal property; not a targeted attraction incentive, so it is off the ladder's dimension.
Bill overview shows Weninger as prime sponsor of a general depreciation-schedule bill, signed into law; not an attraction-incentive instrument.
House final-reading vote on the same general depreciation-schedule bill; the vote does not speak to attracting businesses.

rows.reasoning: The only sources are the sponsorship and final-passage vote on HB 2822 (2022), a bill that adjusts the depreciation schedule used to value business personal property for property tax purposes statewide. It is a general tax-valuation change for existing classified property, not an incentive to attract a large employer, a small/local-business measure, or a conditioned deal of the kind the rungs distinguish, so no passage clears V2 relevance and no chair is evidenced.
needs_source: A statement or record showing whether Weninger supports or opposes targeted business-attraction incentives (e.g., a GPLET deal, a qualified facility tax credit, or a specific employer incentive package) with or without wage/hiring conditions or spending limits.
